symptoms: large translucent gray region in movie detail
gray region when player controls appear
cause: Three context.read<CollectController>() calls requested route-scoped state, but CollectController is registered as a root singleton. The widget throws; Flutter release RenderErrorBox defaults to translucent gray.
fix: Resolve the existing root singleton through inject<CollectController>(); do not hide or recolor the error widget.
reproduction_before: All six targeted widget tests failed with no scoped CollectController provided.
iphone_acceptance: pending user verification after installing the fixed IPA
